verdict: Nasi goreng kampung is better for weight loss. It's about 100 kcal lower, even though pattaya has more protein.
why: Nasi goreng kampung is about 600 kcal, nasi goreng pattaya about 700 kcal.
Pattaya has about 31 g fat compared to 24 g, from the omelette cooked in oil.
Pattaya has more protein, about 26 g compared to 20 g, thanks to the egg.
Both come in a big plate and taste great, so it's easy to finish everything even when you're already full.
when_a: Nasi goreng kampung suits a warung dinner when you want something simple and affordable.
when_b: Nasi goreng pattaya is okay when you want more protein and your other meals that day are lighter.
tip: Ask for less oil and add a fried egg or vegetables. If the plate is big, eat half and pack the rest.

faq.q: Is fried rice really not suitable when dieting?
faq.a: It's fine. What matters is portion and how often. One plate once in a while can still fit into your plan.

faq.q: Is nasi goreng ayam a better option?
faq.a: It usually has more protein from the chicken. Choose chicken that isn't battered and fried to cut down on fat.
